name: Olympiaturm
elevationDatum: Rigid local foundation y=0; real metres +X east, +Y up, +Z south. Two mapped controls fix rotation, baked into the geometry once. No terrain or Mercator stretch.
note: Olympiaturm with a long tapered concrete shaft, three substantial lower equipment tiers with dark grille belts, the glazed revolving-restaurant drum, an upper dish and striped antenna mast. Antenna dish levels, shaft taper and pod dimensions are photo-derived estimates. The permanent 1968 tower with later mast is modeled; temporary renovation scaffolding and the separately mapped entrance pavilion are omitted. Cityscape: not tested; Full 3D world: not tested. Review follow-up: The three lower equipment tiers now have substantial 12.5–13.2 m principal radii, dark grille/panel belts at 156–160, 165–169 and 174–176.5 m, and pale projecting rims. Recessed breaks around 162–164 and 171–173 m keep the stack distinct from the 182–190 m restaurant/observation head. Source/export radial probes pin each grille belt, the gaps and the 291 m tip. New sheet confirms the lower head has weight and a near/far tier ratio consistent with the reference.
